value.rationale: The quantified exact ring classification is physically motivated by flux-controlled coherent absorption, not a free parameter exercise. The gcd invariant shows all trap patterns with equal generated subgroups have identical protected sectors. At single versus antipodal traps, exactly half flux yields complementary, sharp outcomes: perfect protection of an opposite localized input versus elimination of all protected states. This is an exact all-size transport design criterion with meaningful geometry-dependent boundaries.
